claim_scope: Ten reverse-complement classes of DNA dimers, their 1023 nonempty subsets, and all direct maximum-proper-overlap greedy tie breaks.
integrity: Reproduction is by standalone exact integer exhaustive state recurrences with small-instance brute-force cross-checks; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No inference about longer reads, other alphabets, or cycle-cover greedy variants; exact computation is exhaustive only for the specified finite domain.
title: Exact additive-one greedy assembly of DNA dinucleotide fragments
